summary: @servicetitan/notifications preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's `preinstall` hook runs `setup.mjs`, which either uses a system `bun` binary or downloads `bun-v1.3.13` from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases into a temp directory, chmods it to 0755, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated bundle (obfuscator.io-style string-array with a shuffle constructor `WV8StW`, marked `// @bun @bun-cjs`) that runs under the freshly fetched Bun runtime rather than under Node. The package is published as a React notifications UI library, which has no functional need for an alternate JavaScript runtime or an opaque install-time executable. The Bun invocation fires automatically on `npm install`, so any installer of this version runs the opaque payload with the local user's privileges. The Bun-only bytecode container also prevents Node-based static inspection of what the payload does.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
